en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard with two side‑by‑side photographs showing war‑damaged waterfront streets and buildings. People walk along the quay amid ruins, with boats or a harbor edge in the foreground. A circular postal cancellation mark is stamped over the center. French captions are printed along the left and right margins, and there is also a printed reference to the Eastern Campaign and the city of Salonique (Thessaloniki).
